1521. Log Level Counter

70

Hard

Problem Statement:
Log Message Analyzer You are given a system log file containing n log entries. Each log entry is a line of text and may contain one of the following log levels:
"ERROR"
"INFO"
"WARNING"
Your task is to write a Java program that reads n lines of logs and counts how many times each of the three log levels occurs. At the end, the program should print the number of occurrences of each type of log in the following format:
ERROR: <count>
INFO: <count>
WARNING: <count>
input_spec: The first line contains an integer n — the number of log entries. The next n lines each contain a single log entry as a string.
output_spec:
Print three lines with the count of ERROR, INFO, and WARNING entries in that order.
